College

Your Church Home
Away from Home

The college years come with endless excitement, growth, and transitions. Wherever you are in your college journey — freshman, upperclassman, or grad student — Next provides a fellowship of other college-age students who love Christ, love His Word, and love His church.

Sunday Mornings
 9:45am
at The Underground

Join our college Sunday School class in the Main Hall of The Underground. Led by other young adults and mentor couples, there's time for food, fellowship, and time in God's Word with other college students.

Sunday Evenings
6:00pm
at The Underground

Come back on Sunday evenings for a weekly social time with friends. Food, games, and a laid-back time await!

Away for the Holidays? So are we!

If you're planning to attend FBC during the holidays (e.g. summer break, Thanksgiving break, etc.), make sure to check with the church office before attending Next. We might be on break, too!

The Underground Student Center
1181 Two Church Lane - down the street from the Main FBC Building

For questions or more information about our college ministry, contact: info@forestbaptistchurch.org
